<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item&#8201;1.01
Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.</b></span></p>


<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b><i>Operating Agreement</i></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On September&#160;28, 2026, Monroe Capital Asset-Backed
Finance Company, LP (the &#8220;Partnership&#8221;) (including, as context requires, Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP
- Series&#160;I  and Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP - Series&#160;II (&#8220;Series&#160;II&#8221;))
entered into an Amended and Restated Operating Agreement (the &#8220;A&amp;R Operating Agreement&#8221;) with Monroe Capital Asset Finance
Advisors, LLC, the Partnership&#8217;s operating manager, which amended and restated
the Partnership&#8217;s initial Operating Agreement, dated as of July&#160;17, 2026. The amendment and restatement effects certain changes
to reflect the addition of two new classes of shares of limited partnership interest of Series&#160;II, Class&#160;MF Shares (&#8220;Class&#160;MF
Shares&#8221;) and Class&#160;WF Shares (&#8220;Class&#160;WF Shares&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The foregoing summary description of the A&amp;R Operating Agreement
does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the A&amp;R Operating Agreement, a copy of which is
included as Exhibit&#160;10.1 to this Current Report on Form&#160;8-K&#160;and incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Item 5.03 Amendments to Articles of Incorporation
or Bylaws.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b><i>Limited Partnership Agreement</i></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On September&#160;28, 2026, the Partnership executed
its Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement (the &#8220;Second A&amp;R LPA&#8221;), which amended and restated the
Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement, dated as of July&#160;17, 2026. The amendment and restatement effects certain changes
to reflect the addition of Class&#160;MF Shares and Class&#160;WF Shares as well as additional provisions related to borrowings.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The foregoing summary description of the Second A&amp;R LPA does not
purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Second A&amp;R LPA, a copy of which is included as Exhibit&#160;3.1
to this Current Report on Form&#160;8-K&#160;and incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>
